research.note: React and Tailwind components, blocks and landing page templates for SaaS sites, with a paid all-access plan.
unverified: No changelog or dated component release was found; the newest dated item is a blog post dated September 12 without a year, and sitemap lastmod values are all the build time.
Pricing is from the $79 all-access page and 'Free account required' labels on component pages; which components need payment was not checked individually.
